replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
I'm sorry.. but I really feel like this isn't too much up to quality in our new standards. It's flat (there's no terrain), the cover isn't dispersed uniquely and the paths are way too predictable to fight in, the ground is kind of too much in terms of pattern (other than the gravel,sand,grass WorldEdit, I don't see much aesthetic in it). The stone brick mixed with the scatter of natural materials don't seem too well done for looks and could be a bit confusing, and the spawns are too open for spawnkilling. All you need to do is toss an egg in without even having to enter it and you win, or alternatively the Popper kit could just fly from spawn to the middle causing a pretty big unbalance.

The map doesn't have shape other than a cylinder (expected with the design) but it could use more points of access, levelling, better distributed paths, or something to make it less random and more player friendly. This doesn't seem like a map that would be timeless in the CTH community, and by judging off the screenshots itself I'd probably get tired after playing it twice.

I am so sorry if with this feedback I seemed too harsh, because honestly if I got this reply from a mapdev I wouldn't be too happy myself with the work I put into it. I feel like the Gordon Ramsey of Avicus... but I do say that you have the potential to take it somewhere. Try to do more with the crates, cover, pathways, and shape. Try to make it as good as you can.
